headline: World's biggest climate summit ends in failure — here's who said no
label: NEWS
caption:
The world's biggest climate summit just collapsed — and the fight came down to two words: fossil fuels. 🌍

The UN's COP31 talks in Antalya, Türkiye ended without a new climate deal after running two days past their Friday deadline, making it the longest UN climate conference ever held.

The European Union, Pacific island nations and others rejected the final text because it did not directly mention fossil fuels, the main cause of global warming.

Many poorer countries also objected because richer nations made no clear financial commitments to help them cope with rising temperatures.

UN Secretary-General António Guterres said he was deeply disappointed and blamed powerful fossil fuel interests.

Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, whose country co-hosted the talks, pointed to difficult geopolitical times.
